_comment_purpose: Vercel config for the static Workbench SPA (frontend ONLY). Vercel cannot host the FastAPI + DuckDB + Polars backend — serverless functions hit Python cold-start + memory caps on Polars. Pair this config with deploy/fly.toml OR deploy/render.yaml for the backend. See docs/release/public_demo_deploy_plan.md §2 hosting comparison and §3 recommended split-architecture.
_comment_build: Build the React SPA bundle in-place. We run the Vite build that ships with src/nucleus/workbench/ui/ (verified in src/nucleus/workbench/app.py line 37). Vercel auto-detects npm but we declare it explicitly for traceability.
buildCommand: cd src/nucleus/workbench/ui && npm ci && npm run build
installCommand: echo 'skipping root install — buildCommand handles ui/'
_comment_framework: null — we are not using a Vercel framework preset; the SPA is plain Vite-built static assets.
_comment_rewrites: All /api/* requests proxy to the Fly.io (recommended) or Render backend. Set NUCLEUS_DEMO_BACKEND_URL in Vercel Project Settings → Environment Variables before the first deploy. Default placeholder below MUST be replaced — Vercel substitutes $NUCLEUS_DEMO_BACKEND_URL at build time only if the variable is set.
_comment_headers: Security + caching headers. CSP locks asset loading to self + the backend origin so a compromised CDN cannot inject scripts. Cache-Control for static assets is 1 year (hashed filenames); index.html is no-cache so users always see the latest deploy.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://nucleus-demo.fly.dev; font-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'

_comment_redirects: Bare-domain root resolves to the SPA. www subdomain redirects to apex for consistency with demo.nucleus-data.dev convention (plan §8).
_comment_regions: Edge-deploy to two regions close to majority of traffic. Vercel free includes unlimited regions for static assets so cost is unaffected.
_comment_cleanUrls: Strip .html so /docs serves /docs.html. Pretty URLs are friendlier in HN/Reddit links.
